subject.title: docs: add product one-liner to AGENTS.md Start

question: Should root AGENTS.md include this one-line product framing, or should product context remain only in README.md?
rationale: The patch is technically safe, but AGENTS.md is a root agent-policy file and the value of adding product framing there is maintainer/editorial intent rather than code correctness.

options.title: Accept the narrow context line
options.body: Merge the one-line AGENTS.md addition if maintainers want agents to get product framing before reading README.md.

options.title: Close as low-signal docs
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers prefer root AGENTS.md to stay limited to policy and routing rules.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow context line
recommendation.body: Merge the one-line AGENTS.md addition if maintainers want agents to get product framing before reading README.md.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current root AGENTS.md/README.md introduction and is therefore the best history-backed routing candidate for this policy-doc surface.
